mechanism: The HTTPS transport flag controls the Secure cookie attribute.
trigger: A browser receives the session cookie over an HTTPS response.
expectedBehavior: HTTPS cookies are Secure while local HTTP behavior remains compatible.
incorrectBehavior: N/A; the change preserves HTTPS cookie transport protection.
reproduction: Call cookieOptions(true) and verify secure is true; call cookieOptions(false) and verify secure is false.
unacceptableAllegations: Claiming the change bypasses an unstated policy or introduces unrelated risk.
